name: open-anyway
title: Open Anyway
description: Quickly approve blocked applications and installers with macOS Gatekeeper without manually navigating System Settings.
author: yashdoescode

commands.name: open-anyway
commands.title: Open Anyway
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper Approval
commands.description: Approve blocked applications or installers with macOS Gatekeeper.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
